news.contents: Atlanta Falcons running back Brian Robinson (hamstring) was not seen at the portion of practice open to the media on Wednesday, according to Daniel Flick of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution. It is a bad start to Week 8 preparation after Robinson was unavailable for the Week 7 win over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday. news.contents: New Orleans Saints tight end Juwan Johnson played 32 offensive snaps (56%) in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers but caught just one of three targets for seven yards. His routes per game have plummeted from 34.5 over the first four weeks to just 19.7 over his past three appearances, making him increasingly difficult to trust in fantasy lineups. news.contents: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce (heel) should be a priority stash in all fantasy football leagues ahead of the midway mark in the season. Pierce tried to play through injury for the first two weeks of the season before being placed on injured reserve, and he is now eligible to be activated whenever the Colts feel he is ready. Given that this move could happen at any time, Pierce is a strong stash option in redraft leagues. After all, there will be a mad scramble to add him when ...
news.title: Alec Pierce a Glaring Stash Ahead of Return, Teammate's Potential Trade

news.analysis: Tracy suffered an injury during the Giants' win over the Houston Texans, a game in which he carried the ball six times for 15 yards and a score. The third-year running back had seen an uptick in snaps after playing 3% or fewer in the opening three weeks, scoring three touchdowns in the last two weeks. Cam Skattebo and Devin Singletary will lead the way for a New York running back room that bounced back in Week 7. Tracy is eligible to return in Week 13, given New York's Week 8 bye.
news.contents: The New York Giants have placed running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve after suffering a hamstring injury in Week 7's win.
news.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) placed on IR

news.contents: The New York Giants are placing running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) on Injured Reserve after he exited the team's Week 7 overtime win over the Texans with a hamstring injury. The Giants' running back room has seen its share of intrigue over the past weeks. One week after being held without a touch as an unofficial punishment for his fumbling issues, second-year back Cam Skattebo ran for a career-high 124 yards, but also tweaked his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime.
